# TabTasks

Version: 0.5.1. Chrome 116+. English and Simplified Chinese. Local data and no developer analytics.

免费版支持 30 个活动任务、2 个列表、网页和选区收集、备注、子任务、到期日及日历导出。Pro 支持无限活动任务和列表、标签、可读取网页的摘要、JSON 备份及可选 AI 助手。AI 支持 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Anthropic Messages 兼容接口，可自定义服务地址、模型和 API Key；包含 OpenAI、Anthropic、DeepSeek 预设。免费版可配置并测试连接。

Pro: one-time $6, tax shown by Stripe. Automatic activation for extension-started purchases. Optional verified-email recovery requires sender configuration; existing codes remain supported. AI usage is separate if applicable. No cloud content sync or team accounts.

Source: https://github.com/wd9337812/tabtasks
Privacy: https://tabtasks.tabplugins.top/PRIVACY.html
Support: https://tabtasks.tabplugins.top/SUPPORT.html
